about: The one schema every preference block and every owner-rule clause follows. Decision points and their standard facts are declared here as data; bin/jg-clause.sh is the one evaluator over them. A rule that needs a fact no point gathers is the only case for code: add the fact to the point once, never a per-rule script.

route-select.about: jg-model-pool walks its route chain; a skipped route falls through to the next entry.

wake-route.about: when a wake is routed to Main.

captain-message.about: before a message reaches the captain.

clause.whenForms: scalar equals; array is any-of; string with * is a glob; "a-b" against a number is an inclusive range; true/false against a boolean
